name: Local Privilege Escalation
description: A low-privileged attacker has gained initial access and is attempting to escalate privileges to SYSTEM on a Windows workstation using a known vulnerability and token manipulation techniques.
objective: Detect the privilege escalation attempt, identify the method used, and contain the threat before the attacker achieves SYSTEM-level access.

events.message: Process executed: whoami /priv - checking available privileges for user devuser01
SeImpersonatePrivilege token manipulation detected - JuicyPotato-like exploit attempt
Process created with SYSTEM privileges by devuser01 - successful privilege escalation
New local administrator account created: backdoor_admin (SYSTEM context)

hints: SeImpersonatePrivilege is commonly abused for privilege escalation on Windows
Monitor for processes that spawn children with higher privileges than the parent
New administrator accounts created by SYSTEM are a serious red flag
Isolate the host and disable the backdoor account immediately
